hz_source: make_env default OffScreenRenderEnv control_freq=20; source verified, no runtime replay
relative_geometry: world-frame body position and velocity differences; target relative to grip_site also computed
relative_rotation: wxyz converted to matrices; geodesic rotation, no symmetry quotient; not semantic bowl orientation accuracy
gripper_reference: eef_pos is grip_site position in installed robosuite single_arm.py

events.sampled_target_contact_onset: any 0->1 transition at adjacent saved samples; onset interval censored
events.first_sampled_contact_from_uncontacted_r: root has no any-gripper target contact, then a saved contact occurs; not verified grasp
events.sampled_target_contact_loss: any 1->0 transition at adjacent saved samples; not necessarily failure
events.all_samples_target_contact: any-gripper contact true at all five samples; NOT continuous or bilateral grasp
events.sampled_plate_contact: target-plate contact at any saved sample; NOT support or stable placement
events.h8_robot_contact_no_entity_contact: any-gripper target contact at H8 and no target contact with other seven tracked entities; untracked contacts not ruled out
events.sampled_detach_and_rise_5mm: target initially contacts a tracked nonrobot entity; H8 no tracked nonrobot contact, gripper contact, z increase>0.005m; weak evidence only
events.h8_bilateral_contact: existing Stage1 exact H8 _check_grasp; instant only

strong_events.stable_grasp: unavailable: missing dense bilateral/support/holding verification; do not infer negative
strong_events.lift_and_hold: unavailable: missing dense bilateral/support/holding verification; do not infer negative
strong_events.released_stable_placement: unavailable: missing dense bilateral/support/holding verification; do not infer negative

review_rule: up to10 positive and10 negative per listed relation; root-diverse round-robin then candidate order; no Y in selection
label_policy: missing evidence=unknown; sampled point equality does not certify intersample continuity
